ambiguities_or_notes: Every source block (15) has a matching target block, with page markers, numbering, quotation structure, and italics preserved.

Website Circle of Reading paragraphs served as the first draft; each was re-read against the Russian and revised where it drifted (omissions, additions, generic he/his, terminology, attribution form); blocks 9 had no website counterpart and were translated fresh.

«Свойственно» (svoystvenno, 'natural to, proper to') and its negative «несвойственен» are both rendered with 'natural', and «страшный» (strashny, 'terrible') is held as 'terrible' throughout. Reading 3 had no website draft and is translated fresh, keeping Tolstoy's italic *were*; «Зейме» (Zeyme) is the German writer Seume, given by surname only as printed.

Source observation: [9] The block contains a literal «
» after the page marker (a transcription line-break artifact inside the sentence); it is kept in the same position in the English.
